summary: 2026-27 home kit. Rosneft (the club's general sponsor per cska-hockey.ru/club/partners/) carries the jersey: the РОСНЕФТЬ wordmark across the red lower band front and back and on the upper sleeves, plus the Rosneft derrick above the nameplate on the back. A МИР (NSPK) patch sits on the right chest (SKA players wear the same patch in the same match) and a Т-Банк patch on the upper back; NSPK is listed in the syndicated KHL partners block on the club site and T-Bank is a KHL league general partner. An OLIMPBET patch is on the red pants — also on SKA's pants, so the pants branding is league-wide; Olimpbet is additionally an official club partner off the shirt. Socks carry no advertising in club photos; helmets carry СОГАЗ and РОСНЕФТЬ decals, for which the schema has no placement; the KHL league mark and the hockey-80-years patch are not sponsors. All placements checked against the club's 07.09 and 29.09.2026 photo galleries.
